pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft-to-medium edge gradients due to image resolution. Patches exhibit a reduction in spatial area from the mid-neck toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways. Topologically consists of primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pathways maintain relatively uniform pixel thickness across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder mane, visible as a dark brown jagged contour against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple symbiotic birds (oxpeckers) are positioned along the mane and shoulder; a single dark, linear textural mark is visible on the lower-mid flank.
